notEstablished.outcomesEvidence: Not established from the sources consulted for this entry — Legge 142/2014 makes the Commissione Tecnica per l'Inclusione Scolastica the body responsible for monitoring, trialling and evaluating interventions, and requires the educational and dispensative measures to be put to periodic monitoring to judge their effectiveness, but no output of that monitoring was found published. The Osservatorio Scolastico of the Dipartimento Istruzione publishes only pupil counts by school site and class year, with no disturbi evolutivi or special-needs breakdown and no attainment figures. San Marino has no European Agency country page. If you work in this system, this is exactly the field to fill in.
